pair_success: Both verified ground-truth endpoints predicted correctly; no double counting reverse direction
background_isolation: Disjoint physical visible background instances across train/dev/test, including distant buildings and HLOD provenance. Shared mesh/material asset library is disclosed, not called unseen assets.
invalid_pair_policy: Exclude entire matched quartet from comparative metrics if any member has source/pose/label uncertainty; report counts and missing strata
selection_policy: Source geometry and rendering only; no model-score-based viewpoint or hard-negative selection
